title: Minot AFB all ten missiles down after UFO
summary: Robert Salas tells of Minot AFB all ten missiles down after UFO, about September 1966 at Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: Uh again, another witness has come forward, man by the name of David Shindell,

plain: A former US Air Force officer, Robert Salas, says that in September 1966 at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, all ten nuclear missiles at a site went out of action after a UFO appeared. Salas says he learned this from another witness who came forward, a man named David Shindell. If true, it would mean an unknown object was able to switch off American nuclear weapons.
